text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
You must be the class here for work 
experience today. We look forward to 
working with you for the day.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Checking out, right?! I have safely 
received your room key!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Since you didn't use any paid services, 
your checkout is complete! I'll carry your 
luggage to the front door☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-san's majestic yet adorable way 
of serving customers...! Absolute 
perf&ection!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, all the paperwork is in perfect 
order—it's amazing! I need to follow your 
example and do my best, too...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
S-So precious~~!! Is Rob Roy-san's pure 
heart just too precious or what...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, getting to see my fave at work up 
close... these employee benefits are 
insane...! I gotta work even harder to 
support the two of them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Wiping down tatami mats dry is 
really hard work, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's because I'm using completely 
different muscles than usual, but this is 
way more tiring than I thought...!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, but it's totally rewarding☆★☆ 
Let's keep cleaning up and make it 
spotless♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Now that the futons are put away, 
it's time for lunch break!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work...!! It 
really wears on your nerves, so you must 
be exhausted...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's fun, but it is exhausting. I 
had no idea working at an inn was this 
tough...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about how the staff members work 
so hard at the facilities we stay at for 
training camp...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, working is super hard and 
amazing☆★☆ In other words, Marvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nervousness is proof of sincerity☆ 
Physical fatigue is proof of hard work★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Seeing things from the employees' 
perspective was a wonderful discovery, 
too☆ Such a fruitful experience, simply 
marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to this afternoon's work 
too! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... So this is the Marvelous 
philosophy...! What an extraordinary 
mindset...! Praise be, praise beee~~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...! Marvelous-san is always so 
natural and positive!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's your special talent, Marvelous-san. I 
admire you so much!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —There's nothing special about me at all!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I just cherish what's "natural"☆★ The 
"natural" things my family taught me—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mom is always smiling and having fun☆ And 
Dad is super affectionate★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Such ordinary things are the most 
important and marvelous of all—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: My grandma was the one who taught me that!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided to hold onto and 
protect that 'everyday normal' ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Always smiling, accepting and loving 
everything as it is, and constantly 
feeling the Marvelous—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
As long as I cherish this, wherever I go, 
no matter my position, I can stay true to 
myself and have fun☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm Marvelous today too☆ 
Digital, with her broad perspective and 
thoughtfulness, and Rob Roy, who's so 
earnest and polite, are Marvelous★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of us is marvelous☆ So 
let's keep having fun and doing our best 
this afternoon too♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"We are marvelous...! Fufu, somehow I'm 
feeling energized."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Smiles and affection... Such seemingly 
simple things are the foundation of an 
unshakeable sense of self-worth...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~, deeply, deeply moved! I feel like 
I caught a glimpse of Marvelous-san's very 
core!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon. Hearing cheerful, excited 
voices, I turned my gaze over and—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The weather is brilliant and bright☆ 
Marvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
The weather is brilliant and bright☆ 
Marvelous★☆★

Marvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, we're definitely not just goofing 
around! We really wanted to learn more 
about how you think, Marvelous-san...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I respect you from the bottom of my heart! 
If you'd allow it, I'd even love to call 
you 'Master Marvelous'...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Marvelous Sunday found herself 
showered with overwhelming gratitude from 
her classmates.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay, Trainer too, let's goâ 
Marvelouuusâ ââ

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly...! Just chanting it makes my 
heart dance... It's truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Great Marvelous... We must spread this 
even further!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday and the others dashed off 
merrily, delivering marvels all throughout 
the academy.
